points: Showed human feedback lifts Code-as-Policies 1.75× over base VLAs, solving tasks VLAs failed completely
Sole author of the paper's open-source VLA eval framework, deploying chunked actions to a Franka via DROID
Benchmarked π0, π0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MolmoAct2 on 12 real-world manipulation tasks with automated logging
Lead 4-person undergrad team building the software stack for an NVIDIA-granted bimanual holonomic robot
Own base navigation, localization, and arm control, built in MuJoCo and Gazebo, then deployed to hardware
Prototyped three impedance controllers; shipped 500Hz gravity comp (Pinocchio RNEA) feeding motor controllers
Built WebXR/Meta Quest teleop from scratch for sim and real hardware with Cartesian speed limits
Implemented Kalman-filter odometry for sensor fusion, with data-driven tuning on physical competition robots
Led path-tracking rewrite on embedded RTOS, replacing pure pursuit with LQR that models robot dynamics
Fit Gauss-Markov error model validated by Monte Carlo on held-out data: 5.1 cm horizontal, 0.6 cm vertical, <0.5°
Led campaign to raise $50,000+ for a Botswana robotics advocacy trip; built curriculum and taught 50+ students
Presented on Botswana national TV; worked with U.S. Embassy to lobby ministers for reduced STEM kit tariffs
